messages:
Ana: kicking off observability acceptance gates for the new eu-south-1 GPU region. this thread is the single source for the telemetry handoff checklist — logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, alert templates, and cost guardrails. please follow steps and ping when you sign off.

Ana: TL;DR runbook (short):
1) Verify Prometheus scrape stability + node exporter coverage
2) Confirm Loki index templates + retention
3) Validate tracing ingest (jaeger/opentelemetry) and end-to-end trace sampling
4) Import dashboards and sanity-check top panels
5) Run alert firing simulation and confirm pager route mapping
6) Cost smoke: baseline ingestion for 24h, check egress and index growth.

Raj: quick q — what's the default log retention we want for this region? cost sensitivity noted.

Maria: recommend hot retention=30d, frozen/long-term=90d (cold storage). we can drop to 14d if cost spikes during initial ramp. also enable index lifecycle for Loki: 1d chunk time, 7d index retention before moving to cold.

Leo: infra checklist items I'm taking:
- k8s resource requests/limits for observability pods (cpu/gpu-affinity none)
- PVC sizing for loki/tempo ingesters
- HPA thresholds for prom + tempo ingesters
I'll run sizing job and post numbers.

Ana: NOTE: do not enable full debug sampling for traces in prod region — use 1% sampling with a 10% burst cap for onboarding. Maria, can you paste the sampling helm override?

Maria: paste helm overrides here:
```yaml
tracing:
  sampling:
    type: probabilistic
    rate: 0.01
    burst: 0.1
```
Also add the env var OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=region=eu-south-1 for trace grouping.

Raj: cost guard — I scheduled a 24h ingest dry-run this afternoon. payload = synthetic GPU node logs + model-serving telemetry (~500MB/min). expected ingestion ~30GB/day. If Loki index growth > 40GB/day we throttle and revert to 14d hot retention.

Leo: ran sizing job, results:
- Prometheus CPU requests: 500m, limit 2
- Prometheus mem: 4Gi request, 8Gi limit
- Loki ingesters: replicas 3, mem 12Gi each, pvc 200Gi
- Tempo: 2 replicas, mem 8Gi
I'll push the k8s manifests to the eu-south-1 branch.

sre-bot: smoke deploy started for observability/eu-south-1 at 2026-03-18T15:12:00Z (job id: obs-deploy-19321). Logs: https://ci.internal/obs-deploy-19321

Ana: metrics validation checklist (short):
- scrape target count within 95% of expected node/pod count
- rule evaluations < 1s avg latency
- series churn baseline within +/−25% of staging
- tsdb compaction ok (no OOM restarts)

Raj: alert templates to test:
- prom: InstanceDown, HighPromCPU, PromRuleEvalLatencyHigh
- loki: PushBackpressure, IndexRetentionNearLimit, ChunkResourcesLow
- tempo: ExporterErrorsHigh, TraceQueueLatencyHigh
Maria: sample alert jsons (for testing):
```json
{"alert":"InstanceDown","instance":"prometheus-eu-south-1:9090","severity":"critical"}
```

Leo: running alert fire drill now. I'll route simulated alerts to the test oncall: @sre-oncall and confirm routing to PagerDuty.

deploy-bot: alert-drill run completed. 6 simulated alerts fired, 6 routed to test PD service. drill report: https://ci.internal/alert-drill/19321/report

Ana: final handoff criteria (must pass all):
- dashboards imported and no missing datasource errors
- prometheus scrape stability for 30m with <1% target flake
- loki ingestion steady and retention enforced
- trace sampling and ingestion confirmed end-to-end for test traces
- alerts fire and page correctly (drill)
- cost baseline recorded and within expected 20% of forecast

Raj: I'll sign off once cost baseline completes (ETA 24h).

Maria: I've uploaded dashboard jsons to infra/grafana/eu-south-1 and updated datasource defaults. import id: 4728.

Leo: manifests pushed to branch: infra/eu-south-1/observability. PR: https://git.internal/r/eu-south-1/obs/pull/42 — requesting review from @Ana and @Maria.

Ana: thanks team. once PR merged and 24h cost check green @Raj will post final sign-off here. tagging @sre-oncall for visibility. :rocket:

Raj: initial cost baseline looks OK (first 3h). will update after full 24h. :thumbsup:

Leo: leaving a short runbook snippet for oncall responders:
"If Loki ingest spikes >10%/5m -> scale ingesters + alert #loki-ingest-throttling -> if sustained >30m, flip retention to 14d hot and notify infra-eng."

Ana: perfect. closing this thread when Raj posts final sign-off. any blockers call out now.
